response:
It sounds really exhausting to deal with that constant mental traffic all day, and it's completely understandable that you're feeling frustrated. What you're describing—racing thoughts, difficulty focusing, and feeling overwhelmed—can feel really isolating, especially when the people around you have different opinions about what's going on.

I can't tell you whether you have ADHD or not, as only a qualified healthcare professional can make that assessment. What I can say is that your experience is valid, and it's okay to want answers. Many people go through similar struggles, and there are supports and strategies that can genuinely help make things more manageable—whether or not a diagnosis is part of the picture.

Consider talking to a school counselor, doctor, or another trusted adult who can help you explore what's going on and connect you with the right resources. You deserve to feel heard and supported, and you don't have to just "deal with it" on your own.
